comment: Aether's surface registry: one entry per spelling, its synonym class, and the fixture that pins it. Checked by tools/check_surface_registry.py (CTest aether_surface_registry). Classes and status are defined in docs/aether_architecture_and_rationale.md section 5.7.

classes.1: accepted with exact meaning; may be taught. Fixture prints what its canonical twin prints.
classes.2: rejected with a coded diagnostic that names the Aether form.
classes.3: never accepted: silently different across languages. Rejected with a code.
classes.4: tolerated, not taught. Fixture prints what its canonical twin prints.
